violated_contract: An availability escape must not promote a benched or worse-failure-rate provider over a proven stage-5+ alternative. A bench-induced failover surge must not become burst-only evidence that benches the remaining healthy provider and hands full traffic to a worse recovering provider.
canonical_prevention: Rank the escape lead by proven stage-5+ failure rate, hold Modulate below sole full share while Soniox is available, and exclude surge-window deaths only from the burst count while retaining sustained detection. Persist bounded source-bench deadlines with the gate CAS and replay both the burst cascade and sustained-bench recovery, including cold pods and recovery transitions.
